---
title: "[Module Guider 查核清單]{.zh}[Module Guider Verification Checklist]{.en}"
---

::: {.zh}
本站有兩份查核清單，這是其中第一份：涵蓋 `verify/workflow.qmd`
流程裡的 P0–P1、V1–V3、V5、C1–C2 步驟，設計成可列印的一頁。適用對象是使用
**Module Guider**（`askllm`）取得推薦分析與選單路徑的情境；若你用的是 R code
tutor（`askllmr`），請改用 `checklist-rtutor.qmd`。
:::

::: {.en}
This is the first of the two verification checklists on this site. It covers
steps P0–P1, V1–V3, V5, and C1–C2 of the workflow in `verify/workflow.qmd`,
laid out as a single printable page. Use it
when you asked the **Module Guider** (`askllm`) for a recommended analysis and
menu path. If you used the R code tutor (`askllmr`) instead, use
`checklist-rtutor.qmd`.
:::

## [送出前]{.zh}[Before you submit]{.en}

::: {.zh}
- [ ] **P0** 我已經寫下「我會接受什麼答案」（例如：回覆必須指名一個 T-Tests
      底下的分析，並說明為何不是 ANOVA）。
- [ ] **P1** 我已經記下摘要裡的關鍵數字（每一組的 n、mean、sd、遺漏數），
      這些數字之後要拿來跟回覆核對。
:::

::: {.en}
- [ ] **P0** I have written down what answer I will accept (e.g. "the reply must
      name a specific analysis under T-Tests and explain why it is not an
      ANOVA").
- [ ] **P1** I have written down the key numbers from the summary (n, mean, sd,
      missing count per group) so I can check the reply against them later.
:::

## [收到回覆後]{.zh}[After you receive a reply]{.en}

::: {.zh}
- [ ] **V1 路徑核對** — 回覆裡每一條 `Analyses ▸ …` 選單路徑，
      我都在自己的 jamovi 裡逐字點得到（模組名稱、分析名稱、子選項都要對得
      上，不是「差不多」）。
- [ ] **V2 數字核對** — 回覆裡引用的 n、mean、sd 等數字，跟我在 P1 記下的、以及在 Descriptives 面板看到的一致。
- [ ] **V3 範圍核對** — 回覆有沒有宣稱它「看不到」的東西（例如
      常態性、離群值、原始資料列）？如果有，這是「越界」，代表回覆超出摘要
      統計能支持的範圍，應打折扣看待。
- [ ] **V5 交叉核對** — 換一個 persona（consultant / tutor / explainer）或換一個模型，針對同一個 `Question:` 再問一次；兩次的結論
      是否一致？（路徑仍須各自逐條核對，不能因為兩次都提到同一條路徑就省略
      V1。）
:::

::: {.en}
- [ ] **V1 Path check** — Every `Analyses ▸ …` menu path in the reply can be clicked, verbatim,
      in my own jamovi installation (module name, analysis name, and
      sub-option must match exactly — "close enough" does not count).
- [ ] **V2 Number check** — The n, mean, sd, etc. cited in the reply match what I wrote down in P1
      and what I see in the Descriptives panel.
- [ ] **V3 Scope check** — Does the reply make claims about things it cannot actually see (e.g.
      normality, outliers, raw data rows)? If so, flag this as
      "overreaching" — the claim exceeds what summary statistics can
      support, and should be discounted.
- [ ] **V5 Cross-check** — Ask the same `Question:` again with a different persona
      (consultant/tutor/explainer) or a different model. Do the conclusions
      agree? (Still repeat V1 for the second reply — agreement between two
      replies does not substitute for checking each path individually.)
:::

## [結案]{.zh}[Closing out]{.en}

::: {.zh}
- [ ] **C1** 對照 P0 寫下的判準：solved（全部命中，依建議執行）還是 reopen
      （任一項沒通過，需要換個問法或換個 persona 再試）。
- [ ] **C2** 填寫協作日誌四欄：問題 / 判準 / 回覆摘要 / 查核結果。
:::

::: {.en}
- [ ] **C1** Compare the reply against the P0 criteria: solved (everything checks
      out — proceed with the recommendation) or reopen (something failed —
      rephrase the question or try a different persona).
- [ ] **C2** Fill in the four-column collaboration log: question / criteria / reply
      summary / verification result.
:::

## [紅旗（任一項出現就先標「越界」，不要照做）]{.zh}[Red flags (flag as overreaching, do not act on it yet)]{.en}

::: {.zh}
- 回覆聲稱「我檢查過資料的常態性／離群值」——摘要統計不含這些資訊，這不可能
  是真的檢查，最多是猜測。
- 回覆引用的選單路徑在你的 jamovi 版本或已安裝模組裡完全找不到對應項目。
- 回覆引用的 n 或其他數字跟你在 Descriptives 看到的對不起來。
:::

::: {.en}
- The reply claims to have "checked normality/outliers in the data" — the
  summary it received cannot support this claim; at best it is a guess.
- A cited menu path has no matching item anywhere in your jamovi version or
  installed modules.
- A cited n or other number does not match what you see in Descriptives.
:::
